# Notes on recent research

Transformer scaling laws were restated in a 2026 preprint.[^1] The authors argue that the curve bends earlier than expected.

A 2025 paper in Nature Communications reported a related result.[^2]

One widely shared claim traces back to an article that does not exist [3].

Another claim points at a site that was never registered.[^4]

The idea itself is older than any of these papers.[^5]

Google Reader shut down in 2013. The announcement page is gone.[^6]

[^1]: Preprint, https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03173
[^2]: Nature Communications, https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-025-58551-6
[3] Nature Communications, https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-099-99999-x
[^4]: Internal report, https://this-domain-should-not-exist-zx81q.com/report
[^5]: Ashby, W. R. (1956). An Introduction to Cybernetics. Chapman and Hall.
[^6]: Google Reader, https://www.google.com/reader/about/
